timingMethod: Per-cell, per-band acquisition estimates interpolated between embedded line-time records; retain the bracketing timestamps and do not claim exact pixel times.
slopeMethod: Median of all pairwise time-normalized slopes (Theil-Sen), separately per band and fixed geographic point; multiply each point slope by its own span, then summarize across points.

summary.interpretation: Unvalidated exploratory paired-band changes; no cloud-state class, surface irradiance, market edge, or 2 m temperature forecast assigned.
summary.spatialIndependence: Agreement fractions are weighted by the 25 fixed target points. They are not counts of 25 independent infrared measurements; native infrared pixels are reused, and nearby measurements are spatially correlated.
